headline: Silver Age Spider-Man Lot Heads to Auction
post:
Stan Lee’s original run on The Amazing Spider-Man cemented the characters of Marvel’s most popular hero, according to ComicBook.com. Early issues from the Silver Age are among the most sought-after among comic book fans.

Now, a nine-issue lot currently on auction through Heritage gives collectors a chance to own several classic issues at once. The incredible collection includes Amazing Spider-Man #33, featuring the iconic "Final Chapter" storyline where Spider-Man lifts heavy rubble over his head. Other notable issues in the lot feature the debut of Rhino and the unmasking of Norman Osborn.

These foundational stories helped shape the wall-crawler's mythology, influencing everything from modern comic books to cinematic adventures like Spider-Man: Homecoming. 🕷️

What’s your favorite Silver Age Spider-Man comic?

#SpiderMan #Marvel #ComicBooks
original_title: The Green Goblin’s Origin Is a Spider-Man Classic, and This Silver Age Lot Has Eight More Issues to Explore

headline: Marvel introduces a brand new devil-horned Hulk
post:
Marvel just debuted a new devil-horned Hulk, reportedly stripping Bruce Banner of his gamma powers during an exorcism in "Spider-Man/Hulk: Fire and Brimstone #3", according to Screen Rant. 

During the ritual led by Cardinal Leviticus Thornhill, the original Hulk and a mysterious demonic beast emerged alongside a depowered Bruce. Mephisto also made a dramatic entrance during the chaos, claiming that the Hulk has always acted as a cage for Armageddon. 

Several theories surround the true identity of this new creature, including a transformed Cardinal Thornhill, a new aspect of Bruce's powers, or Lahkor the Devourer of Light. 

What do you think is hiding inside this new demonic beast? 😈

#Marvel #Hulk #SpiderMan
original_title: Marvel Officially Unveils New Devil-Horned Hulk, Replacing Bruce Banner
